Plan the Nutrition Intervention Finally, as part of 
the planning, appropriate interventions need to be selected.

nutrition diagnosis, intervention terminology is organized into 
domains. Th ere are four domain categories that identify the

Nutrient Delivery,
(2) Nutrition Educa-
tion, (3) Nutrition
Counseling, and
(4) Coordination of
